Independent Myanmar-media estimates were substantially higher, and the Thai 18-death figure is an early snapshot (ADRC already reports 83 Thailand deaths in its May 7 snapshot). National, cross-border and independent counts need a consistent cutoff and scope. Do not equate the government count with the true whole-event toll or retain 18 as a final Thai total.

Searches did not establish an April 27, 2025 Baghlan flood with these fatalities. The 150 official/300-plus WFP reporting pattern instead matches the May 10, 2024 northern Afghanistan floods, confirmed by contemporaneous May 2024 UN and news reports. The assigned data already has a May 2024 Baghlan event. This suggests a misdated duplicate, not proof that no flooding occurred in 2025. Do not automatically move this row to May 2024 or count both; identity, date and casualty scope require reconciliation.

sources.name: Ministry of Civil Aviation parliamentary answer

records.note: The official report establishes June 12 at 08:09 UTC, Boeing 787-8, Gatwick destination, 242 aboard with one survivor, and 19 ground deaths. Its 0.9-nautical-mile distance is measured from the runway departure end, not an unspecified airport point. The report remains preliminary and does not establish responsibility; no causal claim is added. Omit the unnecessary historical superlative and exact airborne duration rather than leave unsupported ancillary detail.

changes.description: Air India Flight 171, a Boeing 787-8 bound for London Gatwick, crashed shortly after takeoff from Ahmedabad at about 08:09 UTC on June 12, 2025, striking B. J. Medical College hostel buildings. The official preliminary report records 241 deaths among 242 people aboard and 19 deaths on the ground.
sources: Ministry of Civil Aviation parliamentary answer

records.note: June 13-24 is supported, but 1,093 is not a reconciled total. The original roughly 1,060 in Iran is a July 7 official update; the spokesperson raised it to at least 1,062 on July 22. HRANA reported 1,190 using a separate casualty register. Reuters reports 28 killed in Israel, not the original 33; inclusion of indirect or later deaths is not established for the latter. Do not average competing counts or treat different reporting dates as final same-scope totals. The 550-plus missile claim is supported by AP, but the drone count was not established here. Withhold until the overall numeric toll and scope are resolved.

The June 14 shootings, two Hortman deaths, surviving Hoffmans, arrest and June 11, 2026 federal guilty plea are supported. Clarify that the plea was federal: September 2 reporting says Boelter pleaded not guilty in the separate state case, with trial scheduled for November 2. Those different pleas are not contradictory outcomes in the same case. Early morning Minnesota time remains June 14 UTC. No future state outcome is asserted.

changes.location: Brooklyn Park and Champlin, Minnesota, United States
changes.description: On June 14, 2025, Vance Boelter killed Minnesota Representative Melissa Hortman and her husband Mark at their Brooklyn Park home and wounded Senator John Hoffman and his wife Yvette in Champlin. After his arrest, he pleaded guilty to federal murder and related charges on June 11, 2026; the separate state prosecution remained pending as of September 21, 2026.

records.note: Sources establish July 24, 2025 and all 48 deaths (42 passengers, six crew). IAC's English page has a stray July 24, 2024 sentence, contradicted by its own dated 2025 updates and investigation identity; do not propagate the typo. The early 49-aboard figure was revised. News reports describe 15-16 km from Tynda, not consistently the airport, and weather characterizations conflict with an aviation-authority statement that conditions were suitable. Remove those ancillary details; final IAC investigation completion is listed as January 29, 2026, but no unreviewed causal finding is asserted.

changes.description: On July 24, 2025, an Angara Airlines Antonov An-24 operating Flight 2311 crashed near Tynda in Russia's Amur region while approaching its destination. All 42 passengers and six crew members died.
